items.text: Carolina placed both starting corners on injured reserve Wednesday, Jaycee Horn (quad) and Mike Jackson (groin), so rookie Will Lee III, Akayleb Evans and Chau Smith-Wade are the corners for Sunday night vs DET. Jared Goff (DET) is the Menu's stream of the week, and every Detroit pass catcher moved up on the page this morning. Stream Goff at CAR.

John Harbaugh said Jameis Winston starts vs ARI and that J.J. McCarthy, acquired from MIN for a 2027 fifth-round pick, is the No. 2 or 3 while he learns the offense. Malik Nabers (NYG) drew 27 percent of the targets in Winston's first start but caught 5 of 6 for 26 yards at an average depth of target of 1.0. Hold Nabers as a WR2 on volume; what changes the call is McCarthy taking the job, and Week 6 vs NO is the first realistic date for that.
items.why: 27 percent of the targets holds even with a 1.0 average depth of target; the call changes only if McCarthy takes the job, Week 6 vs NO at the earliest.

items.text: The Packers are placing Jayden Reed (GB) on injured reserve Wednesday with the neck injury, per ESPN's Adam Schefter, and he is out indefinitely with no return date. That is at least four games, and Matt LaFleur would not say Tuesday whether Reed plays again this season. Drop him unless you have an IR slot.

Tampa Bay put Jalen McMillan (TB) on injured reserve Wednesday with the PCL strain, designated to return, 6 to 8 weeks per the reporting. Emeka Egbuka and Chris Godwin are the whole receiver room with an undrafted rookie at quarterback; Egbuka is a WR3 on this week's Menu and Godwin a flex. Drop McMillan unless you have an IR slot.

Rico Dowdle (PIT) is a non-participant on Wednesday's estimated report, his third straight DNP on the short week, and he has not practiced since the toe injury in Week 2. Jaylen Warren played 90 percent of the snaps and touched the ball 20 times without him, and he is RB10 on this week's Menu. Start Warren as your RB1 @CLE Thursday night.

Rachaad White (WAS) sat out Wednesday's session in London with the shoulder he hurt vs SEA, and Dan Quinn says he is getting treatment. White played 43 percent of the snaps Sunday, Jacory Croskey-Merritt played 57 percent with 19 carries, and Austin Ekeler made the trip after signing Monday. Croskey-Merritt is the start either way. Monitor White; Thursday's practice report from London.

Jayden Daniels (WAS) was limited in Wednesday's 60-minute jog-through in London, his first practice since he dislocated the left elbow in Week 2, and Dan Quinn says the team will have a definite determination by Friday. Marcus Mariota took every snap vs SEA and threw 3 touchdowns, and he is the WAS quarterback on this week's Menu. Monitor Daniels; Friday's designation.

Mike Evans (SF) will not practice Wednesday while he manages the rib injury from ARI, and Kyle Shanahan says he expects him to play vs DEN. Trent Williams takes a rest day for the stinger and is expected back Thursday. Evans sits outside the ranked depth on the Menu until he practices. Monitor Evans; Thursday's practice.

Mike Vrabel says Drake Maye (NE) stays the starter @BUF after the fourth-quarter benching for Tommy DeVito: 1 touchdown pass, 6 interceptions and 7 turnovers in three games with A.J. Brown on IR. Maye is QB9 on this week's Menu, so the job, not the tape, is the call. Start him as your QB1.

Josh Oliver (MIN) went on injured reserve Tuesday with a torn biceps, so T.J. Hockenson and Gavin Bartholomew are the only tight ends on the roster. Hockenson ran a route on 29 of 37 dropbacks vs TB and got 2 of the 4 targets for 11 yards, even with Justin Jefferson out from the first quarter. More snaps, same targets. Sit Hockenson vs MIA for any Menu tight end.

Rico Dowdle (PIT) did not practice Tuesday, his second straight missed session on the short week, and he has not practiced since he hurt the toe. Jaylen Warren played 90 percent of the snaps and touched the ball 20 times without him. Start Warren as your RB2 vs CLE Thursday.

Matt LaFleur said Tuesday that Jayden Reed (GB) has a neck injury, that he is doing OK, and that it is too early to say whether he plays again this season. Green Bay has not put him on IR and gave no timeline. Drop him in 12-team leagues; keep him only if you have an open IR slot.
The Giants released Odell Beckham Jr. Tuesday after 19 snaps, one target and no catches in three games, and signed Braxton Berrios to the active roster in his place. Drop him.

Tampa Bay signed Brett Rypien to the practice squad Tuesday, and Todd Bowles says undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels still starts vs GB. Daniels went 0 for 3 with an interception in relief of Baker Mayfield. Sit him in every format; he is not a streamer.

items.text: Jayden Daniels (WAS) flew to London with the team Tuesday night and is set to practice Wednesday through Friday in an elbow brace, per Dan Quinn. Washington decides on him vs IND after it sees him work. Monitor the Wednesday and Thursday practice reports.

items.watch: Wednesday practice; a full session is the tell
items.text: Sean McVay says he is hopeful Puka Nacua (LAR) plays at PHI after two missed games with groin soreness, and calls it to be determined. Terrance Ferguson and Jaylen Watson are likely out and Colby Parkinson's shoulder is undecided. Monitor Wednesday's practice; a full session is the tell.

items.watch: Wednesday practice; he needs at least a limited session by Friday
items.text: DeMeco Ryans says he is hopeful Nico Collins (HOU) returns vs DAL after two missed games with a grade 1 hamstring strain. Collins has not practiced since the injury. Monitor Wednesday's practice; he needs at least a limited session by Friday to play.
Dave Canales says Jalen Coker (CAR) has a minor quad strain, and the team calls him questionable for DET. Monitor Wednesday's practice before you plug him in.

Roman Wilson (PIT) was benched for the second half vs CIN after a drop that became an interception, 2 snaps after halftime, so he comes off the Market Run adds list. Monitor his first-half snap share vs CLE Thursday before you spend.
items.watch: first-half snap share vs CLE Thursday

items.text: Ollie Gordon II (MIA) took 84 percent of the snaps after Achane went down, with a fullback and a receiver taking the other 12 at halfback. Miami worked out four backs Tuesday and signed none. Claim him, 20 to 30 percent of FAAB.
Jaylen Wright (MIA) sat Week 3 with a stinger and a foot issue, and Miami's coach said Monday he is day-to-day and could practice Wednesday. Stash him, 5 to 10 percent of FAAB.

Travis Etienne Jr. (NO) had 13 carries for 57 yards before the hamstring went, and Alvin Kamara took 6 of the next 10 carries and 20 of the 34 second-half snaps with CJ Donaldson on third downs. Claim Kamara, 15 to 25 percent of FAAB.

Kenyon Sadiq (NYJ) had three pass catchers out at DET, not one: Mason Taylor (thumb), Adonai Mitchell (finger) and Omar Cooper Jr. (IR). He ran a route on 58 percent of dropbacks and drew 21.6 percent of the targets. Claim him, 12 to 20 percent of FAAB.

The Market Run's Monday night note no longer calls Tyson Bagent the likely starter: Ben Johnson has not named one and said the staff will discuss it. Monitor who takes first-team reps at Wednesday practice.

items.text: Rashee Rice (KC) drew 9 of the Chiefs' 22 targets @MIA in Week 3, a 41 percent share, after 9.5 percent through two games. This week's Heat Check listed 18.7 percent as his Week 3 share; that is his three-game share, and the card is fixed. The buy call stands: trade for him, offer a WR3 and a bench RB.
items.price: a WR3 and a bench RB

items.text: Dallas Goedert (PHI) missed Week 3 with a sprained MCL and is week to week. The Eagles are not expected to put him on IR, so a return vs LAR is possible.

Ben Johnson did not name a Week 4 starter after Case Keenum went 24 of 34 for 247 yards, two touchdowns and a rushing score in the 27-7 win over PHI. Johnson pointed out that Tyson Bagent ended camp as the No. 2, so Bagent is still in play vs NYJ with Caleb Williams out three to four weeks.

items.text: D'Andre Swift (CHI) carried 20 times for 84 yards against his old team Monday night. Twenty carries is the number that matters. Start him as your RB2 vs NYJ.
Saquon Barkley (PHI) ran 15 times for 82 yards @CHI, 73 of them on 11 first-half carries before the game got away. Start him vs LAR.
